title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
prompt:
Implement a trie over lowercase words:

- `Trie()` — construct
- `void insert(String word)`
- `boolean search(String word)` — was this exact word inserted?
- `boolean startsWith(String prefix)` — was any inserted word prefixed by this?

You'll need an inner `TrieNode2` class (named that way here to avoid clashing with the lesson's snippets) with a 26-slot children array and an `isEnd` flag — or name your node class anything you like.

tests.note: prefix of an inserted word is not itself a word; extension of a word is not a prefix

hints: Node class: `TrieNode2[] children = new TrieNode2[26]; boolean isEnd;` (define it as a separate class in the same editor).
insert: walk char by char, creating missing children; mark isEnd at the final node.
Share a private `find(String)` walker: search = found && isEnd; startsWith = found.

solution.explanation: All operations O(word length). The shared `find` walker collapses search and startsWith to one line each — the only difference is whether the final node must be a word end.
